      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.realProjectiveSpace_rank_bound {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] :
      Module.Finite ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R) ≤ (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard

      The real projective space is finite dimensional and its dimension is at most the number of simple modules.

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_presilting_cover_of_simple_rank_le_two {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (hr : (simpleIsomorphismClasses R).ncard ≤ 2) (hR : IsEFinite R) :
      ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R × TwoTerm R)), (∀ p ∈ s, (p.1.directSum p.2).IsPresilting) ∧ ∀ (v : RealProjectiveSpace R), ∃ p ∈ s, v ∈ sectorBetween ((realProjectiveClass R) p.1.projectiveClass) ((realProjectiveClass R) p.2.projectiveClass)

      If the algebra has at most two simple modules, E-finiteness gives a finite cover of its real projective space by compatible presilting pairs.
